resources.string: The DOORS death-message screen. Type the death message below. Separate the messages with a semicolon (;) and each one shows on the screen one at a time, in order, before the screen fades away.
One message per semicolon. Tap anywhere on the screen to advance early; hold for a second to dismiss.
Pale-cyan text on deep navy, with the guiding ambient hum and end chime.
Pale-gold text on deep amber, the Rooms variant. No end chime.
Granted: the death screen can draw over other apps.
Not granted yet. Without it the death screen can\'t appear over other apps.
Built live from the mode and messages above. Paste the link anywhere that can open links, or use the adb / Intent versions from a shell or another app.

Deep link (also works from a browser or adb):
guidinglight://show?mode=guiding&message=Hello%3BWorld

Explicit intent:
action dev.khoichon.guidinglight.action.SHOW
extras: mode (guiding|curious), message ("a;b;c") or messages (String[])

Add the same action to a broadcast (with this app's package) to skip the activity launch. dev.khoichon.guidinglight.action.ABORT dismisses a running screen. Without extras the saved configuration is used.
DOORS and the Guiding / Curious Light belong to LSPLASH. Fan tribute recreating the Scratch death-screen projects; assets extracted from them.
Grant the overlay permission first, then call Guiding Light again.
